description: This file defines classes and traits related to managing Kafka offset ranges within Apache Spark Streaming Kafka integration, including OffsetRange class, HasOffsetRanges and CanCommitOffsets traits.

classes.name: OffsetRange
classes.description: Represents a range of offsets from a single Kafka TopicPartition, with methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create OffsetRange instances with specific parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory method to create OffsetRange instances, overloaded for different parameter types.
